counterfactual.change: moved single field walls[0].x from 9.1 to 9.2 (one-field wall shift away). This increases clearance so grazing corner overlap stays at 0.11 < 0.15; trajectory unchanged (same dt/steps/body state) but no_wall_penetration no longer violated over same 34 steps.

explanation: Shrunk scenario has single body falling past thin wall (w=0.30 at x=9.1, y=2.8-5.0) with r~0.695. Body grazes the wall's top-right corner while moving down-right: vy ~ -7.3 m/s, vx ~1.34 m/s. At step 32 body is just clear (distance +0.09), at step 33 penetration starts (-0.032) and at step 34 it reaches -0.156 exceeding the 0.15 limit. Substeps (5 per dt ~0.017) are insufficient to resolve the fast vertical grazing contact - positional correction / impulse does not push the circle out enough before next integration step, allowing overlap to grow past tolerance while the centre remains just outside the box (corner-side contact). Moving the wall 0.1 m farther in x removes the grazing overlap without changing the trajectory.
vision_note: The red circle drops vertically onto the top of the thin vertical grey wall. At steps 31-33 it is just clear above the wall tip, but at step 34 it visibly sinks into/overlaps the top of the wall instead of making clean contact.
